summary:
Артефактов сборки в индексе нет — только исходники. Публикую.

```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"dd88a27d-b0e9-4d56-b808-2a9da5c6d446","commandId":"publish-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"e0a720a0b8185824d35e09937c677a9ed3d5752e","message":"feat(camera): aim/follow/overview/free modes with smooth transitions

CameraModes: mode machine settings (distance, pitch, fov, smoothing, blend
length per mode) plus hole framing helpers so the overview can show the whole
level before the first shot.

CameraDirector: drives CameraController, CameraTransition and SmoothCameraRig
together. Mode switches, new focus points and the R key all start a timed blend
and keep spring damping, so the camera never teleports. WASD detaches the free
camera, R slides it back behind the ball facing the cup.

Game: loads a hole into an overview fly-around, hands over to the aim camera
when aiming starts, switches to the follow camera on each shot and applies the
smoothed pose through applyCameraPose instead of cameraController.reset().

CameraController: WASD panning moved the target opposite to the view direction;
fixed so the free camera flies where it looks."}
```
